summary: Full backend regression (14 pytest tests, 100% pass) covering auth/role guards, admin barber CRUD, barber self-service PATCH + photo upload to Object Storage, appointment lifecycle, and Stripe checkout returning a real checkout.stripe.com URL plus working /payments/status. Frontend verified: role-based routing works (client -> ClientApp with agenda/barbers, admin -> admin-panel with barbers list, barber -> barber-profile-form). Booking modal opens from barber card and renders service/date/time inputs correctly.

issues: Uses native browser date picker (<input type=date>) instead of a styled calendar component; inconsistent with the premium black/gold theme.
Enzo Martins image rendered as a red/empty block on first paint (Unsplash URL may be slow or blocked). Other two cards load normally.

action_items: Optional: replace native date picker in BookingModal with a themed calendar (shadcn Calendar/Popover) to match premium theme.
Optional: verify Enzo barber seed image URL loads reliably or host a local fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py put_object/get_object use synchronous `requests` inside async FastAPI handlers – acceptable for prototype but blocks the event loop; prefer httpx.AsyncClient for Object Storage calls.

/auth/login reuses register() so a wrong-password hit on an existing email returns 401 (OK), but a brand-new email on the /login endpoint silently creates a new account. Separate login and register semantics are safer.
google_session catch path in App.js still does not clear window.location.hash on failure (carried over from iteration_3) – main-agent action item from previous iteration still open.
seed_data_creation: Tests create a temporary admin-made barber (TEST_barber_*) and delete it; create an appointment then cancel it; patch Enzo profile and revert.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green against real Stripe test key (returns live https://checkout.stripe.com/ URL) and Object Storage (photo upload works, GET /api/files/{path} serves image/*). Frontend login routes correctly to AdminApp / BarberDashboard / ClientApp per user.role. Booking modal uses native date picker – consider styling. Google hash cleanup on failure still unresolved from iteration_3.
